input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 provides automatic one-year renewals (renewal term length is acceptable), but the exit notice window is ninety (90) days — three times our preferred 30-day window and beyond the 60-day fallback, sitting at the walk-away boundary. There is also no pre-renewal reminder from HDI. Fees are a fixed 30% revenue share under Section 3.1 with no uplift mechanism, so no price-increase cap is required. Redline shortens our notice to 30 days (leaving HDI's notice at 90 days so we retain longer runway) and adds a 60-day renewal reminder from HDI; 60 days for our notice is an acceptable fallback.

proposal.summary: Shorten the Company's non-renewal/termination notice to 30 days and require a 60-day renewal reminder from HDI
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We shortened our notice period for exiting the annual auto-renewal from ninety (90) to thirty (30) days and asked HDI to give us a sixty (60) day reminder before each renewal, consistent with our position that auto-renewals must be easy to exit; we can accept sixty (60) days if needed.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
ops.newText: unless terminated by the Company upon thirty (30) days written notice to HDI or by HDI upon ninety (90) days written notice to the Company.

ops.text: HDI shall notify the Company in writing of each upcoming automatic renewal not less than sixty (60) days prior to the applicable anniversary of the Effective Date.
